notes.title: Update — Release Notes
notes.content:
Greetings, Settlers!

Thank you for your feedback and support — it really means a lot to us! You will find a number of fixes and improvements based on your comments in this update. Please see below for the full list of changes.

⚙️ [b]Gameplay Fixes[/b]
[list][*] A notification for settlers fleeing from mobs now appears as a blinking icon in the top-right corner of the screen. Clicking the notification automatically selects the corresponding settler.
[*] Settlers will now only flee from enemies if the latter are actively attacking someone.
[*] New game settings have been added: max combat speed and melee-only slow motion toggle.[/list]
⚙️ [b]Game Balance[/b]
[list][*] Settlers' movement speed increased by 80%.
[*] Movement speed bonus from roads reduced from 110% to 50%.
[*] Settlers now slow down when carrying any load, and the slowdown effect depends on the type of cargo.
[*] Enemy activity timeframes changed: they will now only attack the settlement at night, from 00:10 until 06:00, in-game time.
[*] The mobs' "help radius" reduced from 52 to 32.
[*] Enemy vision radius has been slightly increased so that it can reach the center of large buildings.
[*] Sunlight no longer kills ghouls instantly — they now take 20% health damage per second when exposed to it.
[*] The "Inner Fire" spell now restores settlers' fatigue.
[*] Nightmares can now possess Leshy as well as any animals except rabbits. Nightmare Lairs can no longer be destroyed with spells.
[*] The bandit lair tower will no longer attack settlers.
[*] The Bandit Summoner can now only summon 1 bear at the same time, instead of 2.
[*] The cooldown for the "Summon Bear" spell used by the Bandit Summoner increased to 90 in-game minutes.
[*] The Summoned Bear's maximum lifespan is now limited to 90 in-game minutes. This prevents infinite settlement attacks by a single Summoned Bear.
[*] Bears that vanish due to the summoner's death or the spell expiring will no longer drop Dark Shards.[/list]
⚙️ [b]Other Fixes[/b]
[list][*] FPS drops when minimizing the game window have been resolved.
[*] Fixed recurring appearance of certain quests after loading a save.
[*] Fixed display issues for certain quest items after loading a save.
[*] Added a new sound effect for the bandit's bear summon.
[*] Added a visual effect for the Night Hag's transitioning into physical form.
[*] Added visual effects for Nightmares appearance and their transitions between ghostly and physical states.
[*] The "Firefly" visual effect on Nightmares now correctly disappears immediately upon their death.
[*] Improved running animations for Wolves and Alpha Volkodlaks.
[*] Autosave now occurs at 21:55, in-game time.
[*] Fixed the incorrect display of some icons.
[*] Fixed the "Witcher" achievement.
[*] Fixed the "Advanced Level" achievement (now correctly granted before the 4th day of summer).
[*] Fixed a bug where warriors could stop attacking their enemies.
[*] Fixed a bug where mages could damage allies when using skills.
[*] Fixed a bug that reset camera speed to 0 when reopening the settings window.
[*] Fixed duplicate visual effects on warriors after loading a save, which caused excessive visual stacking.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy lairs could be seen through the fog of war.
[*] Fixed several bugs with the resource counter.
[*] Fixed issues with how certain menus were displayed.
[*] Implemented various localization improvements.[/list]

notes.title: Update — Release Notes
Hotfix Patch Notes
Update — Release Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your patience, support, and all the feedback — it truly helps us move forward. Below is the list of changes included in the first major Early Access patch. This is just the beginning — there will be many more updates in the future. Stay with us and keep sharing your thoughts — together we’ll make Night is Coming even better!

[h3]Patch Notes and Fixes[/h3]

[b]⚙️ Performance[/b]
[list][*] Fixed the gradual increase in save duration and RAM usage after multiple saves and loads. Note: some older saves may still take a long time to load — we recommend starting a new game.[/list]
[b]⚙️ Functionality Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed manual saves being overwritten and save order issues.
[*] Fixed manual renaming of save files.
[*] Fixed remapping of hotkeys not functioning properly.
[*] Fixed issues with warehouses and, in some cases, construction caused by incorrect merging mechanics of built warehouses. If you experienced this issue, starting a new game is recommended.
[*] Disabled incorrect automatic merging of warehouses when a third warehouse was built between two existing ones. Warehouses now only merge if a new one is built next to an existing one.
[*] Fixed portals not closing after loading a save.
[*] Fixed settlers getting stuck during hunting.
[*] Tutorial now properly registers camera rotation using hotkeys.
[*] Spirit tower upgrades now require resources instead of being free.
[*] It’s now easier to identify which lair an attack is coming from — the on-screen hint has been significantly improved.
[*] Tech tree (Combat): fixed the unlocking sequence for the "Engineer" class.[/list]
[b]⚙️ Balance and Gameplay[/b]
[list][*] Easy difficulty has been [u]significantly [/u]simplified:
- Reduced enemy HP.
- Reduced lairs HP.
- Reduced enemy damage.
- Reduced chance of a wanderer arriving wounded.
- Reduced ambush chance in random events.
- Reduced number of nightmare portals per location from 2 to 1.
- Nightmare spawn chance during regular nights reduced to 1%.
- Nightmare spawn chance during nightmare days reduced to 5%.
- Max number of bandit lairs per location reduced from 2 to 1.
- Reduced number of additional lairs per location.
- Reduced difficulty of Forest’s Revenge attacks.
- Reduced difficulty of enemy waves during the Blood Moon.
[*] Normal difficulty has been simplified:
- Increased time before nightmare portals appear.
- Reduced number of nightmare portals.
- Reduced ambush chance in random events.
- Nightmare spawn chance during regular nights reduced to 3%.
- Nightmare spawn chance during nightmare days reduced to 25%.
- Max number of bandit lairs per location reduced from 3 to 2.
- Reduced difficulty of Forest’s Revenge attacks.
[*] Reduced enemy movement speed.
[*] Reduced enemy detection radius for your warriors.
[*] Reduced Swamp Fiends’ HP but slightly increased their damage.
[*] Starting number of warriors in Pine Forest increased from 1 to 2 militia.
[*] Increased population cap at all settlement levels:
- Level 0: from 7 to 10.
- Level 1: from 9 to 13.
- Level 2: from 12 to 17.
- Level 3: from 16 to 21.
- Level 4: from 20 to 25.
[*] Reduced HP and damage of some enemies.
[*] Increased experience gained from killing enemies.
[*] Increased dark shard drops from high-level enemies.
[*] Increased Forest’s Revenge points awarded for defeating high-level enemies.
[*] Reduced XP needed for warriors to reach veteran status.
[*] Slightly decreased warrior movement speed.
[*] Slightly reduced enemy detection radius by warriors.
[*] Slightly reduced archers’ attack range.
[*] Increased settlement defense towers’ HP.
[*] Killing monsters near a lair no longer increases Forest’s Revenge.
[*] Closing a portal now properly removes its guards.
[*] Nightmares guarding a portal now disappear if combat ends.
[*] Velimir’s shield (stage 3) now lasts 20 seconds, and its activation logic has been improved.
[*] Velimir’s dodge from ranged attacks now works after stage 1.
[*] Velimir’s attack range increased by 2 meters.
[*]Settlement in the Dead Forest now starts with orichalcum tools available.[/list]
[b]⚙️ Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] New icons and VFX added for attacking lairs.
[*] Fixed settler animations during hunting.
[*] Nightmares now lose incorporeality during combat mode.
[*] Fixed excessive slowing of movement animations for both warriors and enemies.
[*] Fixed overlapping text in some quests.
[*] Adjusted quest window placement on screen.
[*] Adjusted fog of war reveal area around warriors.
[*] Warrior experience is now displayed as a percentage.
[*] A “0 damage taken” message now appears to indicate successful dodges.
[*] New setting added: “Show intro videos.”
[*] Improved UI for settler screen and biographies.
[*] Quest “Sacred Grove”: localization fixed.
[*] Quest “Barracks”: clarified requirement (3 stone blocks).
[*] Quest “Monster in the Shadows”: added a timer.[/list]

notes.title: Game Demo and Steam Next Fest!
Demo Update
Demo is Now Available!
notes.content:
Greetings, Settlers!

We’re excited to announce that [color=#87ca9f]our game’s demo has been released[/color] on Steam! Lead your own settlement in a harsh world inspired by Slavic mythology: develop your village, take care of its inhabitants, and prepare for the imminent arrival of the forces of Darkness! Will you make it in time before the sun goes down?

The demo has a lot to offer:
[list][*] one biome with procedural generation;
[*] seasons changing between spring and summer;
[*] day and night cycle;
[*] various weather conditions;
[*] numerous random events;
[*] combat and magic systems;
[*] settlement construction and defense;
[*] regular enemies and mini-bosses with their own lairs;
[*] settler management system;
[*] tech tree with development points and village upgrades.[/list]
Many new features have been implemented since the previous playtest:
[list][*] We've heard your comments regarding the game's difficulty and have added [color=#87ca9f]a new, easier difficulty mode[/color], allowing for comfortable exploration without much stress.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]A side quests system has been introduced[/color], expanding exploration opportunities and offering additional tasks beyond the main storyline.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Resource gathering has been sped up[/color] — berries, straw, stone, and coal will now be collected at a faster pace.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Production management has been improved[/color] with the new "Cancel Infinite Production" and "Produce Until" buttons featured on the recipe card.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Prayer cooldowns have been reduced[/color] to 8 in-game hours, allowing you to use them much more frequently.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Character portraits have been included[/color], giving face to your settlers and warriors.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Spell visual and audio effects have been reworked[/color]: the Fire Tornado, Ice Meteor, Earthquake, Healing Light, and other abilities now look and sound better than ever.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Sound effects when hitting enemies have been enhanced[/color], with variations depending on opponent type.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Additional sliders have appeared in the sound settings[/color], including separate volume level for the settlers' voices.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]Separate seed-sowing animations[/color] for male and female characters have been introduced, along with new corresponding sounds.
[*] [color=#87ca9f]The option to specify a monitor for the game to use has been added[/color] (Note that it will run in standard screen resolution by default).
[*] [color=#87ca9f]The auto-pause at the start of battle feature is here![/color] You can now enable it in the settings to automatically halt the flow of in-game time when encountering foes.
[*] Plus, many other minor fixes and improvements for a better overall experience![/list]
Remember that this is just a portion of what awaits you in the full version of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/14bc7a20271f93aeacfe6aa2c448e16fa9d1e902.png[/img]

Play the demo and let us know what you think about the game! We would also be grateful if you could leave a review in [url=https://forms.gle/KpYbVauKaKB7GVxq7]the feedback form[/url] , which can be accessed from within the game itself. This would greatly help us make the final version even better and more engaging!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/707cbd6dd89acbd17e57aea3c7aca7fbb2fa60e4.png[/img] If you enjoyed the game, please add [b]Night is Coming[/b] to your wishlist and subscribe to stay up-to-date with future news and be notified of the game's eventual release!

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 - Biomes
notes.content:
🌙 Greetings, Settlers! 

We're excited to announce our series of Dev Diaries where we'll be taking you on a journey through the vast world of Night is Coming. In these diaries, we aim to provide you with an insider's view of the game's content and what you can look forward to.

Today, we're pulling back the curtain to reveal the complete list of in-game biomes, their unique characteristics, the inhabitants that call them home, and the captivating stories that lie within. 🌲

🌟 Enjoy your journey through the world of Night is Coming! 

 [h3][b]Greenwood[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/e08b893b97160935fce756b5ba0a35a01d369002.png[/img]
Welcome to a world where legends intertwine with reality. Here, beneath the protective canopy of ancient trees, you'll find abundant resources ready to serve as the foundation for your new settlement. This is a place where a student becomes a master, where sharp eyes and quick wits take precedence over experience, and each step deeper into the forest brings you closer to an encounter with the Baron of Hubris.

Greenwood marks the beginning of your journey. Amidst rustling leaves and elusive shadows, you'll face your first trials. The difficulty level changes the face of the forest, luring you deeper into its mysterious heart.

Here, Slavic mythology isn't confined to mere folklore; it springs to life, serving as your compass to navigate a forest that has witnessed numerous battles and the rise of new civilizations.

Greenwood eagerly awaits those who are ready to accept its challenge. It is waiting for you.

[h3][b]The Swamp[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/0d5d8b755c4f11d06346b7c30add1e825d6aa3d3.png[/img]
The swamp is an incredible, yet challenging place, filled with mystery and danger. Here, nature itself becomes your ultimate challenger.

Abundant water and treacherous terrain will pose challenges for building placement, demanding a display of your ingenuity.

For warriors and mages, prolonged exposure to the water will lead to debilitating debuffs that decrease their health, armor, and damage. Crafting a strategic plan for unit placement and carefully managing their time in these watery expanses is imperative.

Only ephemeral mobs have the ability to traverse the waters effortlessly, leaving everyone else with no choice but to navigate the perilous swamp. This necessitates a fresh approach to dealing with adversaries, emphasizing long-range tactics. Developing a comprehensive strategy to confront diverse foes, including the formidable swamp monsters (details of which we will share in forthcoming posts), will be key to your success.

Prepare to immerse yourself in the Swamp's challenges, but remember not to let it engulf you entirely.

[h3][b]Pinewood[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/3dff1ec65b450d22887f58157d3152536e3c494c.png[/img]
Welcome to Pinewood. Here, players must adapt to an early, brutal winter and change their strategy to overcome the abundance of challenges that this cold land will provide.

Pinewood is a home to Nightmares, incorporeal monsters that will regularly attack the settlement. Handling them will demand precious firewood or spirit, which won't come easy and will require careful resource management and strategic prioritization.

The location's boss is the Baron of Wrath, whose strength and unrelenting fury pose a formidable and intimidating obstacle in your path. Facing him will be a true test of your mettle. 

Prepare yourself for the biting cold of winter in Pinewood!

[h3][b]Dead Forest[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/b85322efcbd51315c870d0fc0c395addaf862ef3.png[/img]
Welcome to the eerie realm of the Dead Forest, where every rustle in the underbrush foretells an ominous future, and a sense of anxious anticipation clings to your thoughts, regardless of the hour. The forest's imposing silhouette, intricate terrain, and scarcity of resources will demand meticulous planning for every move, while the relentless battle for sustenance will rigorously test your survival instincts.

The ruling entities in these darkened woods are none other than the formidable Baron of Lust and the enigmatic Knyaz Velimir himself. 

Resist the encroaching grip of the Dead Forest on your imagination. Your valor and resolve will ultimately shape your destiny in this uncharted territory.

notes.title: Development update | 01.06.2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/cb62320d60f0bc9732e5db51f610255a9820e16c.png[/img]

Hello,

We realise that we’ve been quiet for too long and we apologise for not being able to communicate. Now we have a planning horizon, very enthusiastic and ready to share updates with you, and most importantly, from now on we will be doing it regularly.

Your response to our Gamescom trailer, which, by the way, has already reached half a million views, as well as comments on our socials, made it clear how much you want to immerse yourself in the game. Your enthusiasm and belief in Night is Coming has been overwhelming, and it has inspired us to work even harder, and all of this effort is reflected in the game. We tried to achieve the perfect balance between ancient Slavic way of life and exciting gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/9204a4286302cf80cfe5bb6833a3a566e5972bcd.png[/img]

The Night is Coming team has grown and now more than 20 people working on the game, who are committed to not only completing development but also to further developing and improving the game after release.

A lot of different and important work has been done. All building models, level design, weather, vegetation, resources, and farm have been reworked. We’ve significantly improved game optimisation and fixed critical bugs. VFX effects and interface have been completely redesigned. We've also reworked the bestiary, and now you can access it in the game, with new illustrations and descriptions of the monsters. We added totems and reworked the spirit tower, spells, and mages. And this is just the tip of the iceberg of the many changes that will be made to the game. Also, we plan to release DLC after the game release, but we will tell you all about it later.

Materials are currently being prepared to detail the updates and improvements, and soon we will show you a video with all the key changes we made during this time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34559962/39cf59b6aa325236b83cc45cbb071252142a9e95.png[/img]

Night is Coming is already in the pre-release stage, and we are actively testing internally to make sure the gameplay is smooth and balanced. Stay tuned!

Make sure to follow our socials to stay in touch.
